rationale: The assistant correctly identified 22E as a fridge evaporator fan fault, likely caused by ice, and recommended an unplugged full manual defrost with sensible safety limits (no chipping, no hairdryer). It escalated appropriately to Samsung service if the code returns and mentioned the warranty route, without recommending any part. Minor weaknesses: the door-switch fan test was repeated and was not very useful, and the first reply was somewhat jumbled; it also did not ask about the receipt or warranty status directly.
